speaker_role: independent counselor / test-prep/consultancy marketer (IvyBoost counselors, unnamed)
commercial_incentive: Explicitly directs viewers to ivyboost.com to 'speak to a counselor today' — a paid admissions consulting service
key_insights: Myth 1 ('GPA matters most'): GPA matters but one B/lower grade won't sink an application by itself; sacrificing rigorous courses just to protect a perfect GPA is discouraged, since other factors (extracurriculars, tests, recs, essays) carry real weight too.

Myth 2 ('you should have the most extracurriculars'): quality/depth beats quantity; surface-level participation across many clubs doesn't weigh heavily, since activities are meant to show passion, commitment, and growth.

Myth 3 ('essays should focus on your biggest accomplishments'): essays don't need a dramatic life story — they should reveal specific, memorable personality rather than simply restating impressive achievements.
notable_or_distinctive: No distinctive or non-generic content; these are the three most commonly repeated admissions 'myths' across the industry, presented without examples or data.
reliability_notes: Produced by a paid admissions consulting company (IvyBoost) with an explicit call-to-action to purchase counseling services; claims are generic, unsupported by named admissions officers or data, and speaker identity is not given (just 'our counselors').
